end.summary:
Practised visualising square and triangular number sequences with dot pictures.
Explained that moving from 3×3 to 4×4 adds a new row, new column, and one shared corner dot.
Used 12 + 12 + 1 to explain the change from 4×4 to 5×5.
Identified triangular-number additions as 2, 3, 4, then 5.
Dot-picture drawing was not completed unaided; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised showing how square and triangular sequences grow using pictures. Ishita explained the shared corner method and later corrected the counting mix-up by using 12 + 12 + 1 for the new row and column. At home, ask them to draw 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 dot grids and circle the new row, new column, and shared corner.
